jobs.title: Part-Time Security Officer & Mobile Driver - Flexible Shifts
jobs.description:
Allied Universal in Houston is seeking a Security Guard Enhanced Part Time Mobile Driver for reliable, flexible hours at an assigned site, with the option to earn more by picking up additional shifts through our scheduling platform.

Pay rate is $18.75 per hour. A valid driver’s license is required; six-month anchor shift commitment applies. Responsibilities include security procedures, incident response, patrols, and accurate logs.

jobs.title: Armed Patrol Driver — Retail Security, Houston (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
Allied Universal is seeking a Part-Time Security Officer Armed Patrol Driver Documentation in Houston, TX, to serve clients in a range of industries. You will conduct armed patrols, maintain a visible security presence, and provide excellent customer service while following site procedures and reporting incidents.

The role requires a valid Texas Level III Armed Certification, a current driver’s license, and 3+ years in law enforcement/corrections/military or 5+ years armed security.

jobs.description:
Prevail Security Services is seeking a Security Officer to patrol properties, monitor surveillance, and respond to incidents. The role offers multiple shifts (mornings, swing, nights) and emphasizes customer service and professional conduct.

Starting pay is $15.00 per hour. You will enforce procedures, maintain logs, and work with a team to protect clients while advancing in the security field.
